name: @lettland/bb-plugin-model-instructions
description: Add instructions, bundled skills and a Claude Code profile to a thread by its directory, project, provider, model, and whether it is a top-level or child thread.

bb.name: Model instructions
bb.description: Custom instructions and skills per directory, project, provider and model, optionally only for top-level or only for child threads, plus a Claude Code profile per directory. A save that would push any known thread past bb's 4096-character limit is rejected.
